sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Professional - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I might disappoint you, but people talk about a lot of gladiators, not just you. In this business, you have to stay in the spotlight, or no one will remember you a week later. For now, though, you just need to claw your way up... Make a name for yourself so there's something to build the muscles of your fame on. Damn, that sounded good, didn't it? I should write that down."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Earn a Round MVP in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
